rule_enforced: a trophy off a defeated rival, granting no power of its own (powers come from panels)

emblems.name: Deadeye's Lens
emblems.flavor: Popped out while the other eye was still looking for you.

emblems.name: Greytyrant's Crown
emblems.flavor: Took three of your limbs to get.

emblems.name: Nightthroat's Collar
emblems.flavor: Chewed through from the inside. Still stinks of the throat it came off.

emblems.name: Quickfang's Spur
emblems.flavor: Snapped clean off. Its legs were still kicking when it came loose.

emblems.name: Bonelord's Knuckle
emblems.flavor: Still warm when you pried it off.
